<!-- Small mobile fundraising banner -->
<style>
/* css variables */
.frb {
    color-scheme: normal;
    color-scheme: light;
    --wmui-base100: #fff;
    --wmui-base90: #f8f9fa;
    --wmui-base80: #eaecf0;
    --wmui-base70: #c8ccd1;
    --wmui-base50: #a2a9b1;
    --wmui-base30: #72777d;
    --wmui-base20: #54595d;
    --wmui-base10: #202122;
    --wmui-base0: #000;
    --wmui-accent: #36c;
    --wmui-accent-light: #eaf3ff;
    --wmui-accent-dark: #2a4b8d;
    --wmui-red: #d73333;
    --wmui-red-light: #fee7e6;
    --wmui-red-dark: #801919;
    --wmui-green: #00af89;
    --wmui-green-light: #d5fdf4;
    --wmui-green-dark: #14866d;
    --wmui-yellow: #fc3;
    --wmui-yellow-light: #fef6e7;
    --wmui-yellow-dark: #ac6600;
    --frb-body: var(--wmui-base0);
    --frb-link: #233F76;
    --frb-link-hover: #1F3D7A;
    --frb-message-background: #F0ECF6;
    --frb-message-border: #E6E0F0;
    --frb-message: var(--wmui-base100);
    --frb-muted: var(--wmui-base10);
    --frb-muted-hover: var(--wmui-base0);
    --frb-submit: #534FA3;
    --frb-submit-border: #534FA3;
    --frb-submit-hover: #7C6BB3;
    --frb-submit-border-hover: #7C6BB3;
    --frb-error: var(--wmui-red-dark);
    --frb-smallprint: var(--wmui-base20);
    --frb-smallprint-link: var(--wmui-accent);
    --frb-smallprint-hover: var(--wmui-base0);
}

/* darkmode */
html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .frb {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --frb-body: var(--wmui-base100);
    --frb-link: #95a0d8;
    --frb-link-hover: #aab2e0;
    --frb-message-background: #1a1825;
    --frb-message-border: #534FA3;
    --frb-message: var(--wmui-base100);
    --frb-muted: var(--wmui-base50);
    --frb-muted-hover: var(--wmui-base80);
    --frb-submit: #4e2ea1;
    --frb-submit-border: #4e2ea1;
    --frb-submit-hover: #534FA3;
    --frb-submit-border-hover: #534FA3;
    --frb-error: var(--wmui-red);
    --frb-smallprint: var(--frb-muted);
    --frb-smallprint-link: var(--frb-link);
    --frb-smallprint-hover: var(--frb-muted-hover);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    /* automatic mode */
    html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .frb {
        color-scheme: dark;
        --frb-body: var(--wmui-base100);
        --frb-link: #95a0d8;
        --frb-link-hover: #aab2e0;
        --frb-message-background: #1a1825;
        --frb-message-border: #534FA3;
        --frb-message: var(--wmui-base100);
        --frb-muted: var(--wmui-base50);
        --frb-muted-hover: var(--wmui-base80);
        --frb-submit: #4e2ea1;
        --frb-submit-border: #4e2ea1;
        --frb-submit-hover: #534FA3;
        --frb-submit-border-hover: #534FA3;
        --frb-error: var(--wmui-red);
        --frb-smallprint: var(--frb-muted);
        --frb-smallprint-link: var(--frb-link);
        --frb-smallprint-hover: var(--frb-muted-hover);
    }
}

/* Hide nag when editor overlay enabled, or reference drawer open */
.overlay-enabled #frb-nag,
.has-drawer--with-scroll-locked #frb-nag {
    display: none !important;
}

/* Resets */
.frb * {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 100%;
    vertical-align: baseline;
    background: none;
}

.frb button {
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* Box-sizing */
.frb,
.frb *,
.frb *:before,
.frb *:after {
    -moz-box-sizing: border-box;
    -webkit-box-sizing: border-box;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.frb input[type="email"] {
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
}

.frb-replaced {
    white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Hide when printed */
@media print {
    .frb {
        display: none !important;
    }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .frb,
    .frb * {
        transition: none;
    }
}

/* Typography
---------------------------- */

/*Base font*/
.frb {
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Oxygen-Sans", Ubuntu, Cantarell, Lato, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.5; /*24px @16px*/
}

.frb-error {
    display: block;
    line-height: 1.25; /*20px @16px*/
    font-weight: 600;
    margin: 4px 0;
    color: var(--frb-error);
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 14px;
    flex: 0 0 100%;
}

.frb-submit {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.2222222222; /*22px @18px*/
}

/* In-article banner styles
---------------------------- */

#frb-leadacqbanner {
    display: none;
    position: relative;
    color: var(--frb-body);
    margin-top: 14px;
    padding: 0 15px;
}

#frb-leadacqbanner.frb-leadacqbanner--shown {
    display: block;
}

.frb-inline-border {
    position: relative;
    padding: 15px;
    background-color: var(--frb-message-background);
    border-radius: 20px;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 800px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: block;
}

.frb-inline-message {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    padding-right: 30px;
    text-align: left;
}

.frb-message-wrapper {
    flex: 0 1 auto;
    max-width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

@media (min-width: 450px) {
    .frb-message-wrapper {
        min-height: 0;
        margin-bottom: 2px;
    }
}

.frb-message-flex-container {
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.frb-inline-message-text {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.5;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 0.25em;
}

.frb-inline-message-text strong {
    font-weight: 600;
}

.frb-inline-message p:first-of-type {
    margin-top: 0;
}


/* Submit/Continue buttons (blue background) */

.frb-submit {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 8px;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: rgba(84,89,93,0.2);
    background-color: var(--wmui-base100);
    border: 1px solid var(--frb-button-border-hover);
    cursor: default;
    border-radius: 2px;
    transition: background-color 0.5s ease;
    opacity: .5;
}

.frb-leadacq-form .frb-submit {
    color: var(--wmui-base100);
    background-color: var(--frb-submit);
    border-color: var(--frb-submit-border);
    cursor: pointer;
    opacity: 1;
    flex: 0 0 150px;
    max-width: 150px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0;
    margin-right: 100px;
}

@media (max-width: 650px) {
    .frb-leadacq-form .frb-submit {
        margin-right: 0;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 475px) {
    .frb-leadacq-form .frb-submit {
        max-width: 100%;
        border-radius: 2px;
        padding: 11px;
        font-size: 16px;
    }
}

.frb-leadacq-form .frb-submit:hover {
    background-color: var(--frb-submit-hover);
    border-color: var(--frb-submit-border-hover);
}

/* --- Close options --- */

.frb-close {
    color: var(--frb-smallprint);
    font-size: 12px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 10px;
    height: 45px;
    width: 45px;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    z-index: 2;
}

.frb-close:hover {
    color: var(--frb-smallprint-hover);
}

/* Close button icon */

.frb-close-x {
    margin-bottom: -3px;
    width: 21px;
    height: 21px;
}
.frb-close-x {
    stroke: currentColor;
}

/* --- Smallprint --- */

.frb-smallprint {
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: var(--frb-muted);
    font-weight: normal;
    margin-top: 10px;
    flex: 0 0 100%;
}

.frb-smallprint a {
    color: var(--frb-muted);
    text-decoration: underline
}

.frb-smallprint a:hover,
.frb-smallprint a:focus {
    color: var(--frb-muted-hover);
    text-decoration: underline
}

/*!--- Focus styles ----*/

/*Outline reset*/
.frb-submit:focus {
    outline: 0;
}

.frb-submit:focus {
    border-color: var(--frb-button-border-focus);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--frb-button-border-focus), inset 0 0 0 3px var(--wmui-base100);
}

/* --- leadacq form --- */

.frb-leadacq-form {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

@media (max-width: 475px) {
    .frb-leadacq-form {
        display: block;
    }
}

.frb-leadacq-form-legend {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 0 4px;
    padding: 0;
    font-weight: normal;
    text-align: inherit;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.2142857143;
    color: var(--frb-muted);
}

.frb-leadacq-form input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--wmui-base50);
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: #f8f9fa;
    color: var(--frb-body);
    font-size: 14px;
    height: 40px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    flex: 0 1 auto;
    max-width: calc(100% - 350px);
    border-radius: 2px 0 0 2px;
    border-right-width: 0;
    margin-left: 100px;
}

@media (max-width: 650px) {
    .frb-leadacq-form input {
        max-width: calc(100% - 150px);
        margin-left: 0;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 475px) {
    .frb-leadacq-form input {
        max-width: 100%;
        border-right-width: 1px;
        border-radius: 2px;
    }
}

#frb-leadacq-email.frb-haserror {
    border-color: var(--frb-error) !important;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--frb-error) !important;
}

.frb-leadacq-ty {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.44;
    font-weight: 500;
}

</style>

<div id="frb-leadacqbanner" class="frb" role="region" aria-label="lead acquisition banner"><!-- the in-article banner -->

    <div class="frb-inline-border">

        <button class="frb-close">
            <svg class="frb-close-x" aria-hidden="true" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g fill="none" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M2 2l7 7M9 2L2 9"/></g></svg>
        </button>

        <div class="frb-inline-message">
            <div class="frb-message-wrapper">
                <div class="frb-message-flex-container">
                    <div class="frb-inline-message-text">
                        <strong>Sign up for email updates from Wikipedia.</strong> Help keep knowledge free for everyone. Get occasional updates on how Wikipedia stays independent, human-led—and how you can be part of it as a reader, donor, or editor.
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="frb-form-wrapper">

            <form method="post" action="https://localhost:9002/api.php?origin=*" class="frb-lg-form frb-leadacq-form" id="frb-lg-form-email">
                <input type="hidden" name="action" value="leadgen" />
                <input type="hidden" name="leadgen_source" value="{{{banner}}}" />
                <input type="email" name="email" id="frb-lg-email" dir="ltr" autocomplete="email"  placeholder="Enter your email address" autofocus />

                <button class="frb-submit active" id="frb-lg-submit" type="submit">Stay informed</button>

                <div class="frb-error frb-error-invalidemail" style="display: none;">
Invalid
                </div>

            </form>
            <div class="frb-leadacq-ty frb-lg-ty" style="display: none;">
                Thank you! We promise not to send too many emails.
            </div>
            <div class="frb-smallprint frb-localize-links">
                <span>We never sell your information. By submitting, you are agreeing to our <span class="frb-link-privacy">donor privacy policy</span>. The Wikimedia Foundation is a nonprofit, <span class="frb-link-tax">tax-exempt organization</span>.</span>
            </div>
        </div><!--- frb-leadacq-form-email -->

    </div>

</div><!--frb-leadacqbanner-->


<script>
var frb = {};

    mw.loader.using(['mediawiki.util']).then(function() {
        frb.lg.init();
    });

    var language = mw.config.get('wgUserLanguage');
    var country = mw.centralNotice.data.country;

    frb.HIDE_DURATION_CLOSE = 3600; // 1 hour
    frb.HIDE_DURATION_LG = 604800; // 1 week

    frb.hide = function() {
        /* Hide the banner, and remove related event handlers */
        $('.frb').hide();
        $('.frb-prevent-page-jump').hide();
        $(window).off('.frb');
        $('#toc a').off('.frb');
    };

    if ( language === 'pt' && country === 'BR' ) {
        variantLanguage = 'pt-br';
    } else if ( language === 'es' && ['AR', 'CL', 'CO', 'PE', 'MX', 'UY'].indexOf( country ) !== -1 ) {
        variantLanguage = 'es-419';
    } else {
        variantLanguage = language;
    }

    frb.makeLink = function( selector, language, baseUrl ) {
        var url = new URL( baseUrl );
        if ( language ) {
            url.searchParams.set( 'language', language );
        }
        $( selector ).each( function() {
            var $link = $( '<a></a>' );
            $link.html( $( this ).html() );
            $link.attr( { href: url.toString(), target: '_blank' } );
            $( this ).replaceWith( $link );
        });
    };

    // Add links
    frb.makeLink( '.frb-link-privacy', variantLanguage, 'https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:LandingCheck?basic=true&landing_page=Donor_privacy_policy' );
    frb.makeLink( '.frb-link-tax',     variantLanguage, 'https://donate.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:LandingCheck?basic=true&landing_page=Tax_deductibility' );

    frb.shouldShowLeadAcqBanner = function() {
        // Always show when previewing
        if ( !mw.centralNotice.data.campaign ) {
            return true;
        }

        var rawCookieVal = $.cookie( 'centralnotice_hide_fundraising' ), // will we need to detect different cookie?
            hideData;

        // No cookie
        if ( !rawCookieVal ) {
            return false;
        }

        // Try to parse the cookie
        try {
            hideData = JSON.parse( rawCookieVal );
        } catch ( e ) {
            // Corrupt cookie contents
            return false;
        }

        if ( hideData.reason === 'donate' || hideData.reason === 'alreadyDonated') {
            return true;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }

    // Form code
    frb.lg = {

        post: function( $form ) {
		// Email form
		// Post using ajax
		var postUrl = $form.attr('action');
		$.post( postUrl, $form.serialize() );
        },


        init: function() {
        /* Prep the form */
            var formEmail = document.getElementById('frb-lg-form-email');

      	    formEmail.leadgen_source.value = mw.centralNotice.data.banner;

            // Email form submit
            $('#frb-lg-form-email .frb-submit').click(function() {
                if ( mw.util.validateEmail( formEmail.email.value ) ) {
                    frb.lg.post($('#frb-lg-form-email'));
                    $('.frb-lg-form').hide();
	   	    $('.frb-lg-ty').show();
                    window.setTimeout( function() {
                        frb.hide();
                    }, 2500);
                    frb.altSetHideCookie( 'lg', frb.HIDE_DURATION_LG );
                    return false;
                } else {
                    $('#frb-lg-email').addClass('frb-haserror').focus();
                    $('#frb-lg-form-email .frb-error-invalidemail').show();
                    return false;
                }
            });
        }

    };

/**
 * Custom hide cookie function from Core.JS
 */
    frb.altSetHideCookie = function ( reason, duration ) {

	mw.loader.using( 'mediawiki.cookie' ).then( function () {

		var cookieName = 'centralnotice_hide_fundraising',
			date = new Date(),
			hideData = {
				v: 1,
				created: Math.floor( date.getTime() / 1000 ),
				reason: reason
			};

		// Re-use the same date object to set the cookie's expiry time
		date.setSeconds( date.getSeconds() + duration );

		mw.cookie.set(
			cookieName,
			JSON.stringify( hideData ),
			{ expires: date, path: '/', domain: 'localhost:9010', prefix: '' }
		);

	});

    };

    frb.showLeadAcqBanner = function() {
        $( '#frb-leadacqbanner' ).addClass( 'frb-leadacqbanner--shown' );
    };

    $( '.frb-close' ).on('click', function(e) {
        $( '#frb-leadacqbanner' ).removeClass( 'frb-leadacqbanner--shown' );
        frb.altSetHideCookie( 'close', frb.HIDE_DURATION_CLOSE );
    });

    mw.loader.using( 'mediawiki.cookie' ).then( function () {
        frb.showLeadAcqBanner();
    });
</script>
